(Trevor Christensen | The Salt Lake Tribune) Construction equipment gathers radioactive mill tailings at the Utah Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action (UMTRA) Project on Wednesday, Aug. 14, 2024.

The 480-acre site was once the home of a uranium mill that processed 1,400 tons of uranium ore per day.
